WITH search_spend AS
  (SELECT SUM(spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend` AS a
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` AS c ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND a.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     search_conversions AS
  (SELECT COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
          SUM(b.amount) AS total_booking_amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.bookings` AS b
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND b.booked_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     search_leads AS
  (SELECT COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.leads` AS l
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ),
     legacy_channel AS
  (SELECT SUM(spend) AS legacy_spend,
          SUM(leads) AS legacy_leads,
          SUM(bookings) AS legacy_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.legacy.channel_daily`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search'
     AND DAY BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' )
SELECT search_spend.total_spend,
       search_conversions.total_bookings,
       search_leads.total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(search_spend.total_spend, search_conversions.total_bookings), 2) AS cost_per_booking,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(search_spend.total_spend, search_leads.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead,
       legacy_channel.legacy_spend,
       legacy_channel.legacy_leads,
       legacy_channel.legacy_bookings,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(legacy_channel.legacy_spend, legacy_channel.legacy_bookings), 2) AS legacy_cost_per_booking,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(legacy_channel.legacy_spend, legacy_channel.legacy_leads), 2) AS legacy_cost_per_lead
FROM search_spend
CROSS JOIN search_conversions
CROSS JOIN search_leads
CROSS JOIN legacy_channel

   GROUP BY c.channel)

       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur

WITH spend_summary AS

          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id

   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY c.channel)
SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend_eur,
       COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.total_spend, l.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_summary AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN leads_summary AS l ON s.channel = l.channel
WHERE COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) > 0
ORDER BY cost_per_lead_eur ASC;

WITH campaign_spends AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          SUM(spend) AS spend_september
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend`
   WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
   GROUP BY campaign_id),
     campaign_budget_snapshot AS

          budget_eur,
          remaining_eur
   FROM
     (SELECT campaign_id,
             budget_eur,
             remaining_eur,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY campaign_id
                               ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) AS rn
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaign_budgets`
      WHERE snapshot_date <= '2026-09-30' )
   WHERE rn = 1 )
SELECT b.campaign_id,
       b.budget_eur,
       b.remaining_eur,
       COALESCE(s.spend_september, 0) AS spend_september,
       b.budget_eur - b.remaining_eur AS total_used_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.spend_september, 0), b.budget_eur) * 100, 2) AS spend_share_pct,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(b.budget_eur - b.remaining_eur, b.budget_eur) * 100, 2) AS total_used_share_pct
FROM campaign_budget_snapshot b
LEFT JOIN campaign_spends s ON b.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL AS campaign_id,
       SUM(b.budget_eur) AS budget_eur,
       SUM(b.remaining_eur) AS remaining_eur,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.spend_september, 0)) AS spend_september,
       SUM(b.budget_eur - b.remaining_eur) AS total_used_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(s.spend_september, 0)), SUM(b.budget_eur)) * 100, 2) AS spend_share_pct,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(b.budget_eur - b.remaining_eur), SUM(b.budget_eur)) * 100, 2) AS total_used_share_pct
FROM campaign_budget_snapshot b
LEFT JOIN campaign_spends s ON b.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
ORDER BY campaign_id NULLS LAST

WITH weekly_metrics AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          DATE_TRUNC(d.spend_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(d.spend) AS total_spend,
          COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend` AS d
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` AS c ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.bookings` AS b ON d.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
   AND d.spend_date = b.booked_date
   WHERE d.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY c.channel,
            week_start),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT channel,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_w1,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_w1,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN total_spend
              END) AS spend_w2,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN week_start = DATE '2026-09-21' THEN total_bookings
              END) AS bookings_w2
   FROM weekly_metrics
   GROUP BY channel)
SELECT channel,
       spend_w1,
       bookings_w1,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_w1, bookings_w1) AS cpb_w1,
       spend_w2,
       bookings_w2,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_w2, bookings_w2) AS cpb_w2,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_w2, bookings_w2) - SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_w1, bookings_w1) AS cpb_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY cpb_change DESC;

WITH customer_orders_ranked AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_ts,
          order_date,
          amount,

       ROUND(AVG(CASE

                 END), 2) AS avg_returning_order_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE
